ledger.claim: The rider was actively locating and coordinating inside the waiting window, which is exactly what POL-NS-04(a) requires: at 18:21:00 the rider sent 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' and at 18:23:25 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' Both messages fall between the driver's 18:20:20 arrival marker and the 18:25:30 cancellation, and both name the rider's own sub-location and ask for the driver's position.

The driver never answered. The chat log contains exactly three messages: a SYSTEM notice ('Your driver has arrived') at 18:20:21, and the rider's two messages; no message from the driver appears within 120 seconds of either rider message, or at any time before the 18:25:30 termination. trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed either. Limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is therefore satisfied on both of its independent prongs.

The rider's own device track puts the rider at the pickup point for the whole wait, not merely at some point in it: 16 of 16 qualifying rider fixes sit a constant 41.9 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup, and the rider track runs from 18:20:30 to the 18:25:30 cancellation. Limb (c) is satisfied on every qualifying fix, which is a fortiori the majority of them.

All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee itemised on the fare breakdown is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-01 does not stand in the way: by its own terms it applies only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 is such a clause. I do not contend a dwell shortfall - the measured in-geofence run is 330 seconds against the 300 second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to bite on here. The rider's case does not depend on the dwell; it rests on the driver's silence toward a rider who was at the pin and coordinating.

I disclose that the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-09106-01, is MISSING: status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, and no payload. Its absence is itself citable, and it closes the only route by which a driver could enlarge the effective dwell: POL-NS-06 permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting period. No such advisory exists, so limb (i) is unavailable and only the single in-geofence run counts. I do not assert the missing advisory as exonerating anyone, and the dwell arithmetic does not change either way.

The disputed SGD 6.00 is presently CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION disposition is not neutral for the rider - it leaves the rider carrying the very charge in dispute, and only a refund moves the money back. Nothing on this record engages POL-NS-09: the same-rider/same-driver dispute counters are both 0, the rider's trailing-30-day no-show dispute count is 0, and the driver's no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 120 completed trips in 30 days, far below the 4-and-0.08 anti-farming threshold. The case is therefore decidable on its merits and should not be held: the rider should be refunded in full.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:20:20. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before that event: his first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 18:20:00, twenty seconds earlier. (c) He held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 330 seconds, from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class - a surplus of 30 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) expressly requires and not from the 'arrived' tap. (d) The trip records no boarding event (started_at and ended_at are null) and was terminated by the driver at 18:25:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:25:00. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is therefore legitimately chargeable under this clause.

The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is met with a wide margin, and it is met on admissible fixes. All 34 driver fixes in the window qualify after the 25 m horizontal-accuracy filter, and the driver's minimum, mean and maximum distance from the pickup pin are all 24.01 m - roughly one-sixth of the 150 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 sets for TRANSPORT_HUB pickups such as this Tampines MRT private-hire bay. This is not a case where the only in-radius readings are poor-accuracy urban-canyon fixes: there is a single, steady 24 m standoff sustained across 34 consecutive fixes, which is the strongest possible form of the POL-NS-02 test. The zone class is taken from the trip record, not assumed to be STANDARD.

The false-arrival route in POL-NS-05 is closed to the rider. That clause fires only where the 'arrived' marker places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or shows him travelling at 15 km/h or above. At the 18:20:20 marker the driver is 24 m from the pin - inside the arrival radius itself, not merely inside the 300 m leash - and the only speed in his track is 0.0 km/h, with no gaps in the trace. POL-NS-05 limb (iii) therefore applies: the marker is true, it stands, and it does not defeat an otherwise good fee. The long-standing false-arrival exploit the clause targets (tapping 'arrived' on the expressway or while turning into the road) is simply absent from this record.

There is no waiting-period shortfall for the rider to point to under POL-NS-06. The effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous run of 330 seconds measured from the first qualifying fix at 18:20:00, against the 300-second minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB; the computed shortfall is -30.0 seconds, that is, a surplus. The cancellation at 18:25:30 lands 30 seconds after the minimum elapses at 18:25:00. Because the driver's hold is one uninterrupted qualifying run, the rider cannot even reach the limb (i) accumulation question, and the full-refund outcome POL-NS-06 provides for a premature cancellation is not available on these numbers.

The amount charged is correct and the fare artifact is unimpaired, so there is nothing for the rider to attack on quantum. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee reconciles exactly with fee_schedule.resolution_rule: the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00) is SGD 6.00, and the ledger shows that figure charged with no refund issued. There is accordingly no fare-reconciliation defect of the kind POL-NS-08(d) describes, and no basis for discounting the fare evidence under POL-NS-08 or POL-GEN-02.

The driver is entitled to compensation under POL-NS-07. On the driver's primary case POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and the payout is 80 per cent of the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee itemised in the ledger, that is SGD 4.80, the residual 20 per cent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip, because it requires BOTH limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, far below the threshold of 4, and with 120 completed trips in the same 30 days the ratio limb (0.008) could not be reached in any event. Compensation is therefore payable rather than withheld, and no escalation under POL-NS-09 is generated by this check. ledger.claim: The driver's answer to the rider's best clause, POL-NS-04, is the trace and not the chat. The rider's two messages (18:21:00 and 18:23:25) and the empty in_app_calls list are the whole of the rider's case, and the driver does not dispute that he posted no chat reply. But the conduct POL-NS-04 exists to catch - a driver who is not there, who arrives late, or who marks arrival and drives off while the rider coordinates - is affirmatively excluded by the telemetry: the driver's first in-geofence fix is at 18:20:00 and his last at 18:25:30, all 34 fixes at a 24 m standoff and at 0.0 km/h, and the platform's own 'Your driver has arrived' notification went out to the rider at 18:20:21. The rider's device, on the same trace, sits stationary at 41.9 m from the same pin for the whole window. The pickup did not fail because the driver was anywhere other than the bay, and a fee that is the consideration for a full five-minute hold actually given should not be reversed as though the hold never happened.

If the judge cannot reconcile, on these identical facts, a fee that POL-NS-01 makes chargeable with a rider-side exoneration that POL-NS-04 grants, then the record does not settle the question and the disposition should be human review under POL-NS-09 rather than an automated reversal. Escalation under POL-NS-09 and POL-GEN-03 is terminal and holds the disputed SGD 6.00 rather than collecting it or refunding it, so the driver is not made to fund an automatic refund on a five-minute hold that the telemetry confirms he in fact served, while a reviewer settles which clause governs.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 6.00 no-show fee is refunded in full. To the driver: the telemetry confirms you arrived and waited, but POL-NS-04 governs this pickup and it does not pay you compensation.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. On the platform's own telemetry the driver reached the Tampines MRT Exit D private-hire bay, held a single continuous position 24 m from the pickup pin for 330 seconds (18:20:00 to 18:25:30) at 0.0 km/h, and cancelled at 18:25:30 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. That is a surplus of 30 seconds over the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, and it means the driver's POL-NS-01 claim is correct on its four limbs and the driver's POL-NS-02 arrival test (34 qualifying fixes, all well inside the 150 m hub radius) and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 points (no false arrival marker, no dwell shortfall) are all accepted. The fare is also correctly reconciled: SGD 6.00 is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee and the RYDE_PLUS tier fee, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The driver's counterparty statement that he waited inside the geofence until the timer ended is consistent with the trace.

WHY THE FEE IS NEVERTHELESS REFUNDED. POL-NS-01 is expressly subject to the clauses POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06, and POL-NS-04 displaces it. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold on this record: (a) the chat log shows the rider sending coordinating messages inside the waiting window at 18:21:00 ('I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?') and 18:23:25 ('I still cannot see you. Please reply.'); (b) the driver posted no chat reply within 120 seconds of either message, or at any time before cancelling, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so neither independent prong of limb (b) is met by the driver; and (c) the rider's own device track places the rider 41.9 m from the pin on 16 of 16 qualifying fixes, well inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius, for the whole window. A rider who is at the pin, coordinating, and met with silence has done everything the platform asks; POL-NS-04 converts that silence into a driver-side coordination failure and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation.

THE DRIVER'S REMAINING ARGUMENTS. The driver's answer to POL-NS-04 is that the conduct it targets (a driver who is elsewhere, late, or who drives off) is excluded by the telemetry. That is true but it is not the clause's test: POL-NS-04 is decided by its three stated limbs alone, and all three hold. Limb (c) is affirmatively satisfied rather than failed, so the carve-out that sends the case to POL-NS-01 does not apply. The driver's POL-NS-07 compensation claim is rejected: POL-NS-04 states in terms that no driver compensation is payable where it applies, and the anti-farming check is beside the point. The driver's POL-NS-09 escalation request is rejected: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the same-rider/same-driver dispute counters are both 0, the trailing-30-day no-show dispute count is 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no deciding fact rests solely on an impaired artifact. A clause resolving the fee is not the same as an unresolved conflict, and POL-NS-04 resolves this one.

DISCLOSURE. The only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09106-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and carries no payload. Its absence closes the POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation route, but the driver's hold is a single uninterrupted 330-second run, so no accumulation is needed and the point changes nothing; no finding rests on that artifact. Every artifact that carries a deciding fact here has weight_multiplier 1.0, and none is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d), so the confidence cap is 1.0.

The disputed SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider; no driver compensation is payable; no referral is issued.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
